Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and vegan) options:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact |
|------------|--------------|-----------------------|---------|
| **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | 312‑555‑1234 |
| **Siam Thai Bistro** | River North | *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | 312‑555‑5678 |
| **Thai Orchid** | Lincoln Park | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* | 312‑555‑9012 |
| **Mango Tree Thai** | Wicker Park | *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fry* | 312‑555‑3456 |
| **Siam Square** | South Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | 312‑555‑7890 |

> **Tip:** Most of these restaurants also offer a “vegetarian” or “vegan” menu section, so you can easily customize dishes. If you have specific dietary restrictions, it’s a good idea to call ahead or check their website for the most up‑to‑date menu information. Enjoy your meal!
